categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Vico Precision Mold & Plastics Co., Ltd. primarily operates in automotive electronic precision components, non-automotive connectors and parts, and precision molds. The company focuses on R&D, manufacturing, and sales of these products, serving mainly the automotive industry with a strong emphasis on automotive electronics and related components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including precision mold development, injection molding, stamping, winding, welding, assembly, and testing. It employs digital and automated manufacturing systems integrating ERP, CAD, CAM, PLM, CMM, and MES for mold design and production. The firm emphasizes lean production, automation, and intelligent manufacturing lines to ensure high precision and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global leading automotive parts suppliers such as United Automotive Electronics, Bosch, BorgWarner, TE Connectivity, and Amphenol. The end markets are primarily automotive manufacturers including SAIC Volkswagen, SAIC General Motors, Great Wall, Geely, BYD, Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi, Nissan, and others. The company also serves non-automotive sectors through connector products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production facilities and subsidiaries in Shanghai, Changzhou, Singapore, and Thailand. It serves both domestic and international markets, with approximately 78% of revenue from domestic sales and 22% from exports.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Vico Precision Mold & Plastics Co., Ltd. operates as a tier-2 supplier in the automotive supply chain, providing precision components and molds to tier-1 automotive parts suppliers who then supply to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in automotive electronics, especially in new energy vehicles and intelligent driving systems. R&D focuses on developing high-performance connectors, electromagnetic valves, sensor components, and power modules for electric vehicles. It invests heavily in automation, digitalization, and green manufacturing, aiming to enhance product quality, reduce costs, and expand into emerging markets like hydrogen fuel cells and autonomous driving.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of precision automotive electronic components, connectors, molds, and related parts. The company follows a direct sales model, engaging in synchronous product development with customers and fulfilling orders based on customer demand forecasts and contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global automotive parts suppliers and connector manufacturers but positions itself as a reliable tier-2 supplier with strong R&D and manufacturing capabilities. It maintains long-term partnerships with leading tier-1 suppliers and has a competitive edge in precision mold development and automated production lines.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 843 million, an 11.13% increase from the previous year, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 45.3 million, a 29.44% decrease. The company has shown steady revenue growth and increased R&D investment, with a workforce of about 798 employees and total assets exceeding RMB 1.5 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Vico emphasizes zero-defect quality, advanced precision manufacturing, and comprehensive one-stop services integrating mold design, production, and testing. Its competitive differentiation lies in its strong synchronous R&D collaboration with customers, high automation and digitalization levels, and ability to deliver complex, high-precision automotive electronic components tailored for new energy and intelligent vehicles.
